title: Mixed-language UI with Language = Automatically Detect: connection file dialogs appear Italian while main UI is English
author: bruste77
body_snippet:
**Summary**
When mRemoteNG is set to Automatically Detect language, the main UI appears in English, but the connection file configuration dialogs (Open/Save) appear in Italian on systems configured with Windows display language en-US and locale/format it-IT.

This creates an inconsistent user experience and suggests different culture sources are used by different UI components.

**Version**
Nightly Build — 20260804 (v1.82.0)

**Environment**
OS: Windows 10/11
Windows display/UI language: en-US
W...
